title: Show open items that exist only in a sibling worktree
lead: An open item filed in a linked worktree and never committed is invisible on the other checkout. `list` and `status` stay quiet, and `check` stays green, because an id that exists only in the sibling is not a collision.
findings_note: roadmap review 2026-10-05: s192-s201 were open only in a sibling worktree and main's list stayed empty; first filed as s203 on the superseded feature/agents-feedback branch
boundary: **Not in this slice:** failing `check` for a sibling-only id (`test_Check_IdOnlyInSibling_NoWarning` stays). Copying or importing the sibling's items. Renumbering. Reading other branches with `git show`. Statuses other than the open status.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `store._elsewhere_counts` returns false when this checkout has no item with that id, unless the sibling row is claimed or in-work (`src/slicer/store.py`). An unclaimed open item therefore never reaches `list`'s `in_work_elsewhere` map or `status`. s185 compares titles only when both indexes contain the id. `sibling_ids` already reads the sibling indexes. On 2026-10-05, s192 through s201 were open only in `.worktrees/agents-feedback` while `main`'s `list` omitted them and `next-id` was s203.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `test_List_OpenOnlyInSibling_NamesIt`: the sibling adds an unclaimed item in the open status that this checkout does not have. `list` exits 0. Text names the id, the title, and the worktree name under an `Only in a sibling` heading. `list --json` stays a bare array of items, unchanged: it has no `only_in_sibling` and no row for the sibling-only item. `check` still exits 0 with no collision warning.
2. `test_Status_OpenOnlyInSibling_NamesIt`: `status` exits 0 and prints the same id, title, and worktree. `next` is unchanged. `status --json` includes `only_in_sibling`, a list of `{id, title, worktree, status}` in worktree-path order, then id order.
3. `test_List_KnownId_NotOnlyInSibling`: an id present in both checkouts is not under `Only in a sibling` in `list` text and not in `status`'s `only_in_sibling`, including when the sibling's status differs. A claimed or in-work sibling row stays in `in_work_elsewhere`.
4. `test_List_SiblingDoneOnly_IsNotListed`: a done item that exists only in the sibling is not listed under `Only in a sibling` and not in `only_in_sibling`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Report sibling items whose id is absent here, whose status is the sibling's open status, and which are neither claimed nor in-work. `list` text and `status` (text and JSON) gain this report; `status --json` carries it as `only_in_sibling`. `list --json` is a bare array of items (docs/agents.md) and does not change: a top-level key cannot be added to it without breaking its consumers, so agents read sibling-only items from `status --json`. A `list --json` envelope that can carry non-item data is a separate item.

`list` and `status` text print an `Only in a sibling` heading and one line per row, `ID  worktree  title`, only when the report is non-empty. A checkout with no such sibling item prints exactly what it does today.

Do not change `check`, `next`, or the `in_work_elsewhere` rules.

CHANGELOG under `[Unreleased]`, `### Fixed`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: The failing tests pass, then `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`, `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m slicer check`, and `git diff --check`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, including the re-rendered roadmap and a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.
